system.description: This infectious stench exposes people within range to disease. Failed resistance causes 1d6 minutes of incubation, then 1d6 days of fever with -2 to all actions. Successful resistance grants one day of immunity to this ability. Incubation and disease persist after leaving the area.
system.summary: Spreads an infectious stench; exposed people must resist the disease.
